variant_traits: empty suit of medieval plate armor

visual_overrides.core_identity: An empty suit of medieval plate armor animated as one complete construct, with no visible wearer inside.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Full humanoid armor silhouette with rigid plates separated by clearly empty gaps.
visual_overrides.head_features: Closed or partly open helmet with empty darkness where a face would be; no eyes, flesh, or skull.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Articulated breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves, and boots moving as one hollow suit.
visual_overrides.surface: Broad simple metal plates with a few dents and edge lines; no ornate engraving.
